name: Unemployment
description: Job openings and separations, sector employment, laborParticipation, matchingFriction; show age and regional unemployment separately. Participation is a companion condition, not a second unemployment bonus.

name: Real household purchasing power
description: medianIncome, wages, household taxes and transfers, and a consistent consumer-price basket (costOfLiving). Show food, housing, and energy components; define currency/era conversion before comparing countries.

name: Poverty
description: Income distribution, transfers, real purchasing power, household size; childPoverty and deep poverty are subgroup readouts, not separately stackable law targets.

name: Income inequality
description: Decile shares, wage dispersion, taxes and transfers, regional income gaps; keep mobility separate because equal current income does not imply opportunity.

name: Output growth
description: Sector output, investment, trade, labor hours, productivity; show a multi-turn trend so a one-turn rebound does not masquerade as durable prosperity.

name: Productivity growth
description: Output per hour, workforce skill, capital investment, rdIntensity, roboticsAdoption; technology adoption is a driver with labor consequences, not a free governance buff.
unit: % real output per hour change, annual

name: Price stability
description: Consumer-price change, food/energy/housing prices, volatility. Introduce only if the economic engine owns a real price process; otherwise leave this as a diagnostic, not a fabricated 0-100 score.

name: Trade balance
description: Exports, imports, exportDependency, tradeGrowth, sector competitiveness. Surplus is not always “better”; display balance and exposure without a moral direction.

name: Fiscal balance
description: Actual revenue, operating/capital outlays, transfers, interest, mandatory obligations. The treasury ledger owns this fact; legislation never writes it directly.

name: Debt burden
description: Debt stock, nominal output, interest costs, maturity, fiscal balance. Show debt-service pressure alongside the ratio; a lower ratio is not a standalone policy objective.

name: Secondary completion
description: Attendance, dropout, school capacity, teacher availability, completion by region and income. Use country-appropriate school labels without changing the underlying completion definition.

name: Learning attainment
description: testPerformance, subject proficiency, UK gcseAttainment. The current test index and GCSE pass percentage have different units; map them through a documented country/era calibration, not a silent alias.

name: Workforce skills
description: Adult literacy, apprenticeships, vocational completions, employer skill gaps, retraining uptake. apprenticeshipRate is a pathway, not another outcome bonus.

name: Tertiary access
description: Admissions, completion, affordability, regional capacity, research-university places. Enrollment alone should not grant the same productivity effect as achieved skills.

name: Research capability
description: rdIntensity, trained researchers, labs, relevant outputs and commercialization. R&D spending is an input; define an era-aware capability measure before making it a headline.

name: Effective health coverage
description: uninsuredRate, eligibility, enrollment, geographic service reach, and practical access. Coverage is not identical to affordability or the existence of a national health service.

name: Care affordability
description: Out-of-pocket costs, premiums/copays, household income, medicine prices, medical debt where modeled. Keep separate from coverage.

name: Treatment delay
description: Referral backlog, staffing, beds, clinic throughput, UK nhsWaitingTime; display the NHS label in the UK and comparable access-delay concepts elsewhere.

name: Preventable mortality
description: Primary-care access, treatment delay, chronic-disease management, avoidable deaths by cause. Do not award a second direct law bonus to life expectancy for the same saved lives.

name: Life expectancy
description: Age-specific mortality, preventable mortality, safety, environment, long-run care quality. Treat as a slow, derived outcome with demographic adjustment.

name: Mental-health access
description: Provider capacity, wait times, geographic coverage, unmet need, school/community provision. Distinct from general treatment delay where care pathways differ.

name: Elder-care quality
description: Care staffing, service coverage, safety, dependency pressure, family burden. Especially salient in JP, but not exclusive to it.

name: Public-health preparedness
description: Surveillance, trained workforce, labs, emergency stockpiles, response exercises and regional coverage. Program spending and department capacity are inputs; only delivered capability changes this outcome.

name: Housing cost burden
description: Rent-to-income, mortgage-to-income, housingAffordability, rentalPressureIndex, income, price and interest data. Show renters/owners separately.

name: Housing supply
description: Completions, starts, approvals, vacancies, land and construction capacity; housingCompletionsRate is a leading signal, not a separate headline improvement.

name: Road condition
description: Maintenance backlog, bridge safety, pavement state, project completion; use infrastructure spending as input, not the outcome.

name: Transit access
description: Coverage, frequency, reliability, ridership, travel-time access; transportEfficiency is a diagnostic composite.

name: Broadband access
description: Household coverage, speed, uptime, price, rural access; era-gate before broadband exists.

name: Safe water
description: Contamination, treatment compliance, outages, infrastructure age; require separate regional evidence before averaging nationally.

name: Grid reliability
description: Outage duration, reserve margin, grid maintenance, transmission capacity. Distinct from national fuel security below.

name: Violent crime
description: Offense counts by type and region; UK knifeCrimeRate is a subtype where useful. Avoid also applying the same incident to generic crime as an independent gain.

name: Nonviolent crime
description: Property and other nonviolent offenses. Define a clean split from current crimeRate before migration; UK antiSocialBehaviourRate remains a local diagnostic, not automatically the same offense category.

name: Incarceration
description: Sentencing, pretrial detention, diversion, prison capacity. This is a system condition with tradeoffs, not a simple “lower is always better” score.

name: Recidivism
description: Cohort reoffending, rehabilitation access, employment and housing after release; use stable cohorts and a visible lag.

name: Air quality
description: Particulates, other pollutants, industrial/transport emissions and weather; publish exposure by region, not only source emissions.

name: Carbon emissions
description: Power mix, transport fuel, industry, agriculture. Choose total versus per-capita units explicitly; do not reward offshoring emissions by ignoring imports.

name: Renewable energy share
description: Generation by source, installed capacity, storage and curtailment. energyTransitionProgress becomes a derived summary rather than a second independent target.

name: Climate/disaster resilience
description: floodRisk, naturalDisasterPreparedness, protective works, response capacity and realized damage. Separate exogenous hazard exposure from governmental preparedness.

name: Conservation
description: Protected area, habitat condition and land-use pressure; acreage alone is insufficient if quality is not modeled.

name: Social mobility
description: Income movement, education access, regional opportunity and intergenerational outcomes; distinct from current inequality.

name: Homelessness
description: Sheltered/unsheltered counts, housing burden, roughSleeping, supportive-housing capacity; use consistent country definitions.

name: Food insecurity
description: Food prices, real income, nutrition support, local access and economic.foodSecurity; distinguish household access from national supply resilience.

name: Social cohesion
description: Intergroup trust, segregation, unrest, local inclusion, regional differences. Avoid making any group's identity itself a negative input.

name: Civic participation beyond voting
description: Volunteering, local participation, association membership and community activity; exclude election turnout so it is not double-counted.

name: Gender opportunity
description: Employment and earnings gaps, education access, safety, representation; show component gaps rather than a single unexplained moral score.

name: Newcomer integration
description: Labor outcomes, language access, housing, legal protection, belonging; the metric measures opportunity and inclusion, not the number of foreign workers.

name: Government transparency
description: Disclosure, auditability, response to information requests, budget publication. Legal requirements and enforcement capacity are inputs.

name: Corruption
description: Audit findings, procurement irregularities, enforcement and verified cases; rising detection can initially increase reported cases, so interpret the trend carefully.

name: Public trust
description: Survey confidence, service delivery, scandals, fiscal credibility and rights protections; this is a downstream perception, never a direct generic law bonus.

name: Civil liberties
description: Due process, privacy, protest and speech protections, enforcement practice. Legal regime and actual practice should be visible separately.

name: Voter turnout
description: Eligible turnout, registration, ballot access and election competitiveness. Keep apart from broader civic participation.

name: Press freedom
description: Legal protection, censorship, ownership independence and journalist safety; stateMediaControl is a system detail, not its only inverse.

name: Disinformation exposure
description: False-content reach, media literacy, platform dynamics, mediaPolarization, newsTrust; distinguish exposure from trust in news or the BBC.

name: Population change
description: Births, deaths, migrationRate, regional movement; show shrinking and growing regions separately. Change is descriptive, not universally good or bad.

name: Fertility
description: Age-specific births, family costs, care access and household formation; use a country/era context band rather than maximizing births.
unit: births per woman, total fertility rate

name: Dependency burden
description: medianAge, working-age population, child/elder shares, labor participation. demographicDecline becomes a derived warning, not another writable score.

name: Military readiness
description: Personnel training, equipment availability, maintenance, logistics and defense funding; spending is an input and force availability is the result.

name: Energy security
description: Fuel-import dependence, reserve margin, source diversity, storage and contingency supply. This measures exposure to disruption, not the same thing as day-to-day powerGridReliability.
unit: fuel exposure and reserve-cover risk band
